locations.rationale: The method call on greeter resolves to Greeter.prototype.greet because greeter is returned by createGreeter as a newly constructed Greeter.
The method call on direct resolves to Greeter.prototype.greet because direct is explicitly constructed as a Greeter.

records.rationale: The complete fixture contains exactly two identifier tokens outside the declaration that resolve to the selected Greeter method. The unrelated CommonJS accepts method and other component bindings do not resolve to greet.
